Its bundle /static/js/main.bb703140.js loads the order list from the API base 'https://dev.erckerala.org/api' (endpoints 'orders' and 'licensees'). The request to https://dev.erckerala.org/api/orders was refused by this session's permission policy (auto-mode classifier), so no orders were retrieved. 'Appendix - List of Objectors' attachments excluded. Excluded: transmission (TPC-T, AEML-T, MSETCL, InSTS), generation, RE/PPA adoption, IA-only orders. Smaller distribution licensees (Mindspace, Gigaplex, KRCIPPL, JNPA, LBSCML, MADC, NUPLLP, EON Kharadi I/II, MITL Bidkin/Shendra, SEZ Bio-Tech, AEML SEEPZ) also have MYT orders of 28-03-2025 (NUPLLP 22-10-2026) on the same listings but were not requested and are not included.
